title: Verdict
description: One specialist's finding on one claim, for one pass.

verdict.description: supported: two independent sources agree with the claim as written. contradicted: sources show it is wrong. partly_supported: core is right but a detail is wrong or overstated. unverifiable: fewer than two independent sources either way. out_of_scope: wrong specialist.

corrected_text.description: For contradicted or partly_supported: the narrowest accurate wording the sources support.

citation.description: Author, title, date, and the specific record, page or section.

locator.description: Page, chapter, catalog number, or paragraph.

derives_from.description: If this source repeats another (for example a site quoting Wikipedia), name it.

checked_text.description: True only if the wording or figure was read in this source, not inferred from a summary.

searched_without_result.description: Where you looked and found nothing. Required for unverifiable and for negative claims (for example, 'never served in Congress').

trap_hits.description: Ledger refs of known traps this claim matched.

needs_archive_access.description: If only an archive the team cannot reach could settle it: which archive and what to check.
